terms.section02.intro: Dripn is a personal fashion decision engine that enables users to:
terms.section02.bullet2: Chat with personalised AI stylists for fashion advice.
terms.section02.bullet3: Build and manage a digital wardrobe.
terms.section02.bullet4: Access personalised styling advice based on your preferences.
terms.section02.bullet5: Discover fashion deals, events, and trends.
terms.section02.bullet6: Subscribe to premium features for enhanced experiences.

terms.section03.sub02.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must immediately notify us of any unauthorized use of your account.

terms.section03.sub03.body: Each user may maintain only one account. Creating multiple accounts may result in termination of all accounts.
terms.section04.title: 4. Subscription Plans and Payments
terms.section04.sub01.title: 4.1 Subscription Tiers
terms.section04.sub01.intro: Dripn offers the following subscription tiers with varying features:
terms.section04.sub01.bullet1: Free: Limited stylist decisions, wardrobe items, and AI chat.
terms.section04.sub01.bullet2: Personal Stylist: Unlimited decisions, wardrobe-aware advice, video posts, and extended AI chat.
terms.section04.sub01.bullet3: Stylist Unlimited: Everything in Personal Stylist plus outfit calendar, unlimited wardrobe, and planning tools.
terms.section04.sub02.title: 4.2 Billing
terms.section04.sub02.body1: Paid subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis. On iOS, subscriptions and in-app purchases are processed through the Apple App Store (in-app purchase support is rolling out). On web and Android, payments are processed securely through Stripe. By subscribing, you authorize us to charge your payment method through the applicable platform.
terms.section04.sub02.body2: One-time purchases (such as Done-For-You styling setups) follow the same platform rules: App Store on iOS when available, otherwise Stripe on web.
terms.section04.sub03.title: 4.3 Automatic Renewal
terms.section04.sub03.body: Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage your subscription through your account settings or the app store.
terms.section04.sub04.title: 4.4 Refunds
terms.section04.sub04.body: Refunds are handled according to the policies of the platform through which you subscribed (Apple App Store or Google Play Store). For direct purchases, refund requests may be considered on a case-by-case basis within 14 days of purchase.

terms.section05.sub01.body: You retain ownership of content you post ("User Content"). By posting content, you grant Dripn a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, display, reproduce, and distribute your content in connection with the Service.
terms.section05.sub02.title: 5.2 Content Standards

terms.section05.sub02.bullet2: Contain nudity, sexually explicit material, or adult content.
terms.section05.sub02.bullet3: Promote violence, hatred, discrimination, or harassment.
terms.section05.sub02.bullet4: Include spam, misleading information, or commercial solicitation.
terms.section05.sub02.bullet5: Impersonate others or misrepresent your identity.
terms.section05.sub02.bullet6: Contain malware, viruses, or harmful code.
terms.section05.sub03.title: 5.3 Content Moderation
terms.section05.sub03.body: We reserve the right to remove any content that violates these Terms or is otherwise objectionable, at our sole discretion and without prior notice.
terms.section05.sub04.title: 5.4 Promotional Use of Content
terms.section05.sub04.intro: By posting photos or videos on Dripn, you grant Dripn the right to use your content in promotional materials, including but not limited to:
terms.section05.sub04.bullet1: Social media promotional reels and posts.
terms.section05.sub04.bullet3: App Store and Google Play Store promotional materials.

terms.section05.sub04.body: Your content may be featured in curated style highlights, trend showcases, or "best of" compilations. We may overlay text, apply filters, or edit content for promotional purposes while maintaining the integrity of the original. You will be credited where reasonably practical. If you wish to opt out of promotional use, you may contact us at privacy@dripn.app to request removal from future promotional materials.

terms.section08.intro: Dripn provides AI-powered fashion recommendations as a guide. You acknowledge that:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.welcome1: Your trust means everything to us. We know that sharing personal information requires confidence in how it will be handled, and we take that responsibility seriously.
privacy.welcome2: This policy explains, in plain language, what information we collect, why we collect it, and how we keep it safe. If you ever have questions, our support team is always here to help.
privacy.intro1: Welcome to Dripn. Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Dripn ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, discloses, and protects your personal information when you use our mobile application and related services (collectively, the "Service").
privacy.intro2: By using Dripn, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use our Service.
privacy.section01.title: 1. Information We Collect
privacy.section01.sub01.title: 1.1 Information You Provide
privacy.section01.sub01.intro: When you create an account, use our Service, or contact us, you may provide:
privacy.section01.sub01.bullet1: Account information: name, email address, password, gender, and country.
privacy.section01.sub01.bullet2: Profile information: profile photo, style preferences, body measurements, and fashion interests.
privacy.section01.sub01.bullet3: Content: photos, videos, outfit posts, comments, and voice recordings you share.
privacy.section01.sub01.bullet4: Communications: messages, feedback, and support requests.
privacy.section01.sub01.bullet5: Payment information: billing details processed securely through Stripe.
privacy.section01.sub02.title: 1.2 Information Collected Automatically
privacy.section01.sub02.intro: When you use our Service, we automatically collect:
privacy.section01.sub02.bullet1: Device information: device type, operating system, and unique device identifiers.
privacy.section01.sub02.bullet2: Usage data: features used, interactions, time spent, and preferences.
privacy.section01.sub02.bullet3: Location data: approximate location based on IP address or precise location if you grant permission.
privacy.section01.sub02.bullet4: Camera and photo library access: only when you choose to upload content.
privacy.section01.sub03.title: 1.3 Information from Third Parties
privacy.section01.sub03.body: We may receive information from third-party services you connect, such as social media platforms for login or sharing purposes.
privacy.section02.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
privacy.section02.intro: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.section02.bullet1: Provide, maintain, and improve the Dripn Service.
privacy.section02.bullet2: Personalize your experience with AI-powered fashion recommendations.
privacy.section02.bullet4: Display regionally and gender-appropriate fashion content.
privacy.section02.bullet5: Send notifications about your account and styling updates.
privacy.section02.bullet6: Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support.
privacy.section02.bullet7: Detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, and security issues.
privacy.section02.bullet8: Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service.
privacy.section03.title: 3. AI and Automated Processing
privacy.section03.intro: Dripn uses artificial intelligence to provide personalized fashion advice. When you request AI recommendations:
privacy.section03.bullet1: Your outfit photos may be analysed to provide styling suggestions.
privacy.section03.bullet2: Your style preferences and history inform personalised recommendations.
privacy.section03.bullet3: We do not use your photos to train AI models without explicit consent.
privacy.section03.body: You can disable AI suggestions in your Settings at any time.
privacy.section04.title: 4. Information Sharing and Disclosure
privacy.section04.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information:
privacy.section04.bullet1: With service providers: Payment processors (Stripe), email services (SendGrid), analytics, and cloud hosting providers who assist in operating our Service.
privacy.section04.bullet2: With AI services: Your styling data is processed by our AI systems to provide personalised recommendations.
privacy.section04.bullet3: For legal reasons: When required by law, court order, or to protect rights and safety.
privacy.section04.bullet4: Business transfers: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets.
privacy.section04.bullet5: With your consent: When you authorise us to share information.
privacy.section05.title: 5. Data Retention
privacy.section05.intro: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. After account deletion:
privacy.section05.bullet1: Most data is deleted within 30 days.
privacy.section05.bullet2: Some data may be retained for legal, security, or fraud prevention purposes.
privacy.section05.bullet3: Anonymised data may be retained for analytics.
privacy.section06.title: 6. Your Rights and Choices
privacy.section06.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
privacy.section06.bullet1: Access: Request a copy of your personal data.
privacy.section06.bullet2: Correction: Update or correct inaccurate information.
privacy.section06.bullet3: Deletion: Request deletion of your account and data.
privacy.section06.bullet4: Portability: Receive your data in a portable format.
privacy.section06.bullet5: Opt-out: Disable marketing communications and AI suggestions.
privacy.section06.bullet6: Restriction: Limit how we process your data.
privacy.section06.body: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@dripn.app or use the in-app Settings.
privacy.section07.title: 7. Data Security
privacy.section07.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including:
privacy.section07.bullet1: Encryption of data in transit and at rest.
privacy.section07.body: While we strive to protect your data, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.
privacy.section08.title: 8. International Data Transfers
privacy.section08.body: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
privacy.section09.title: 9. Children's Privacy
privacy.section09.body: Dripn is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us immediately, and we will delete it.
privacy.section10.title: 10. Third-Party Links and Services
privacy.section10.body: Our Service may contain links to third-party websites, affiliate shopping links, or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.
privacy.section11.title: 11. Updates to This Policy
privacy.section11.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the new policy in the app and updating the "Last Updated" date. Your continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.section12.title: 12. Contact Us
privacy.section12.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
privacy.section13.title: 13. Region-Specific Provisions
privacy.section13.sub01.title: For European Users (GDPR)
privacy.section13.sub01.body: If you are in the European Economic Area, you have additional rights under GDPR including the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. Our legal bases for processing include consent, contract performance, and legitimate interests.
privacy.section13.sub02.title: For California Users (CCPA/CPRA)
privacy.section13.sub02.body: California residents have the right to know what personal information is collected, request deletion, and opt-out of the sale of personal information. We do not sell personal information. To exercise your rights, email privacy@dripn.app.
privacy.section13.sub03.title: For UK Users
privacy.section13.sub03.body: UK residents have rights under UK GDPR similar to those in the EEA. You may contact the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) with any concerns.
